Report Description////////THIS IS AN UPDATE FOR NRC REPORT NUMBER 1293360.//////// UPDATED INFO: - 5,000 POUNDS OF ADIPIC ACID RELEASED FROM A RAIL CAR (#MGRX50093). - 60 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL WAS DISCHARGED FROM A LOCOMOTIVE (#NS9384). - CONTRACTOR IS ONSITE. - THEY SUSPECT EVERYTHING WILL BE CLEAR BY TOMORROW AFTERNOON. - RELEASE WAS STOPPED AND THEY ARE USING VACUUM TRUCKS FOR CLEANUP. - CALLER STATES SHOULD NOT BE A POTENTIAL FOR ANY OTHER MATERIAL RELEASE SINCE RESPONSE CREWS ARE ONSCENE. ORIGINAL REPORT: CALLER IS REPORTING THE DERAILMENT OF APPROXIMATELY 20 RAILCARS AND A POTENTIAL DISCHARGE OF DIESEL FUEL, FLAMMABLE LIQUIDS, PHOSPHORUS (RESIDUE), AND ADIPIC ACID ONTO THE GROUND AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE CAUSE OF THE DERAILMENT IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME. OF THE 20 RAIL CARS THAT DERAILED 2 WERE LOCOMOTIVES AND 6 WERE TANK CARS. NO INJURIES WERE REPORTED. DAMAGES ARE EXPECTED TO EXCEED THE $150,000 THRESHOLD AND THE TRACK IS CURRENTLY CLOSED. THE CONTENTS OF THE TANK CARS ARE AS FOLLOWS: 4 TANK CARS WERE EMPTY PHOSPHORUS CARS 1 TANK CAR CONTAINED A FLAMMABLE LIQUID 1 TANK CAR CONTAINED ADIPIC ACID

Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: NB COATINGS
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 1300 gallons
SUSPECTED RELEASE TO AIR BY EVAPORATION OF AMYL ACETATE (CAS # 628-63-7). PUMP FAILURE IN BULK STORAGE TANK AREA CAUSED LIQUID RELEASE TO A CONTAINMENT DIKE. SPILL RECOVERY OF THE LIQUID WAS ACCOMPLISHED WITH ON-SITE PERSONNEL. UPON COMPLETION OF SPILL RECOVERY, AN INVENTORY DISCREPANCY OF APPROXIMATELY 1,000 GALLONS (7,000 LBS) WAS DISCOVERED. CHECKED SEWERS FOR EVIDENCE OF RELEASE TO WATER; NO EVIDENCE WAS FOUND. AT THIS POINT, MOST LIKELY EXPLANATION FOR MISSING INVENTORY IS EVAPORATION. LIQUID LEAK WAS DISCOVERED AT 10:55AM. CLEAN-UP WAS COMPLETED AND MISSING INVENTORY DISCOVERD AT 12:45PM. ALL RECOVERED LIQUID WAS STORED IN STEEL DRUMS TO BE MANAGED AND DISPOSED OF AS RCRA HAZARDOUS WASTE.
